newsitem.title: USA: Egypt may have bought up to 70,000T US wheat-trade.
newsitem.headline: Egypt may have bought up to 70,000T US wheat-trade.

text.p: Indications are that Egypt has bought between 60,000 and 70,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat on Wednesday in a private sale, several U.S. exporters said.
One position of 30,000 to 35,000 tonnes was slated for last half June and the balance was set for last half July, they said.
"I think it was done extremely cheap. That is what the rumor is, I can not confirm it," the exporter added.
"I heard that but I think it actually happened," another U.S. exporter said.
A third exporter also said the business had been done.
